title: Giraffe Buns
description: Light, spongy bread buns made from eggs, cream of tartar and cream cheese. The crust crackles and puffs like a giraffe's golden coat when baked.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Line two baking sheets with greaseproof paper.
Separate the eggs. Whisk the whites with the cream of tartar to stiff peaks.
Microwave the cream cheese for 10 seconds to soften slightly. Mix into the egg yolks until combined.
Slowly fold the whites into the yolk mixture with a metal spoon, a little at a time.
Use a ladle to dollop the mixture on to the sheets, 5cm apart. Bake for 20–22 minutes until puffed with a mottled crust.
Cool completely on the baking sheets.
notes: Makes 6 buns. Keeps 3–4 days in a sealed container. Freshen up in a toaster or under the grill.
